description: Rings the user's phones. After one answers, dials the destination into that same conversation. The result shows as an outgoing phone call. The user speaks on it. Pro plan. If no phone answers, the destination is not dialled.

destination.description: Phone number to connect after the user answers.

identity_id.description: Optional. You may set it. If you omit it, Widely picks the caller ID. If you set it, it must be an identity_id from list_identities, one of the user's own. Never invent another number. A grant limited to several numbers still needs identity_id.

name: request_call
title: Place a call
